TITLE: Board View – "Estimated hours" Field Never Shows on a Card
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10048 (Ready for QA, read 9 Oct 2026) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10048

h2. Description

When *Estimated hours* is turned on in *Fields to display*, *each card should show the work order's estimated hours*.

For example,
* a work order's lines carry estimated time
* Estimated hours is turned on
* the card shows every other chosen field, but no Estimated hours

In production a work order's estimated time is the sum of its lines' estimates.

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* and the *PRD* (S5-R11).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open a work order whose lines have an *Estimated Time* (e.g. 0.3, 1.5 and 0.4 h).
# Open *Work Orders* > *Board View* > *Fields to display* and turn *Estimated hours* on.
# Find that work order's card.
#* The card shows the other chosen fields but *no Estimated hours*.
#* The same at *Compact*, *Regular* and *Comfortable* density.

*Actual Result:*
* No card shows Estimated hours, even when the work order's lines carry estimated time.

*Expected Result:*
* The card shows the work order's estimated hours (here *2.2*).

h2. Sources

* [PRD – Work Orders Board View & Tech View|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] — S5-R11, read 8 Oct 2026:
{quote}Offer the optional fields listed below using their existing production meaning.{quote}
The field list in S5-R11 includes *estimated hours*.
